title: [spec-gap][R-11-019] preferred_rx_valid_until_sfn not scoped to schedule generation (spec 17.5.3)
description: Spec 17.5.3: preferred_rx_valid_until_sfn is scoped to the schedule generation that established the peer contract; a generation change invalidates that validity, and an SFN from another generation MUST NOT extend it. Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: preferred_rx_valid_until_sfn is emitted as a bare u32 with no generation context in any stack (C coap_status.c:667-676 ccp map of 3 fields; no rust equivalent; python pass-through); no code compares SFN against schedule generation anywhere (announce/scheduler paths carry no generation tag). Spec explicitly notes this should use schedule context without a new field. Suggested placement: plumb the active schedule generation id (already implicit in 02a CCP peer-contract state) into the /status ccp encoder and validate on read/report side; add a vector to lci_status.json pinning invalidation on generation change.
